body.name: Release v3.2.0
body.body:
## 🚀 Android GPUImage Plus v3.2.0

### 📦 Downloads

**Demo APK:**
- `cgeDemo-3.2.0.apk` - Demo application with full video features

**AAR Library Artifacts:**

Four variants are available for different use cases:

1. **gpuimage-plus-3.2.0.aar**
   - Page size: 4KB (default)
   - Full-featured with FFmpeg bundled
   - Architectures: armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86, x86_64

2. **gpuimage-plus-3.2.0-16k.aar**
   - Page size: 16KB
   - Full-featured with FFmpeg bundled
   - Architectures: armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86, x86_64

3. **gpuimage-plus-3.2.0-min.aar**
   - Page size: 4KB (default)
   - Image-only version (no video features or FFmpeg)
   - Architectures: armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86, x86_64

4. **gpuimage-plus-3.2.0-16k-min.aar**
   - Page size: 16KB
   - Image-only version (no video features or FFmpeg)
   - Architectures: armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86, x86_64

### 🔧 Gradle Dependency

```gradle
allprojects {
    repositories {
        maven {
            url 'https://maven.wysaid.org/'
        }
    }
}

dependencies {
    // Choose one of the following based on your needs:
    
    // Full-featured with FFmpeg (4KB page size)
    implementation 'org.wysaid:gpuimage-plus:3.2.0'
    
    // Full-featured with FFmpeg (16KB page size)
    implementation 'org.wysaid:gpuimage-plus:3.2.0-16k'
    
    // Image-only, no video (4KB page size)
    implementation 'org.wysaid:gpuimage-plus:3.2.0-min'
    
    // Image-only, no video (16KB page size)
    implementation 'org.wysaid:gpuimage-plus:3.2.0-16k-min'
}
```

### 📋 System Requirements

- **Minimum Android SDK**: API 21 (Android 5.0)
- **Target Android SDK**: API 25
- **NDK Version**: r27c
- **Supported Architectures**: armeabi-v7a, arm64-v8a, x86, x86_64

### 📚 Documentation

- **GitHub Repository**: https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus
- **Build & Integration Guide**: https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/blob/master/docs/build.md
- **Filter Rule Documentation**: https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/blob/master/docs/filter-rules.md

---

For complete changelog, see the auto-generated content below.


## What's Changed
* ci: release workflow overhaul – draft releases, master validation, direct maven commit, NDK r27c/r29 by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/564
* feat: Implement CameraX support with runtime camera API selection by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/565
* feat: add zoom ratio API (setZoomRatio) to ICameraProvider by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/566


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/compare/v3.1.2...v3.2.0

For complete changelog, see the auto-generated content below.


## What's Changed
* Some new feature from #510 by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/512
* new option: disable video module by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/516
* fix crash: https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/issues/524 by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/526
* Add a Demo that can use a matrix to control FilterView by @phcbest in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/534
* Support 16 KB page sizes by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/537
* bugfix #540 : `immutable texture` can not be resized by glTexImage2D by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/541
* Add ffmpeg with 16kb page size support, add prebuilt 16kb aligned libraries in the README by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/543
* Fix GL stub symbol conflicts for 16KB page size support in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/545
* Replace GL_TRIANGLE_FAN with GL_TRIANGLE_STRIP for better performance in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/547
* Add conditional 16KB page size support for Android 15+ compliance in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/546
* chore: add workspace instructions by @LeeGoDamn in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/559
* docs: restructure documentation and optimize README by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/560
* Improve video recording quality and simplify native library loading by @wysaid in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/561

## New Contributors
* @phcbest made their first contribution in https://github.com/wysaid/android-gpuimage-plus/pull/534
